static_review.authorization_assessment: The eight AUTHORIZATION constants are local one-shot/frozen-execution control markers. Their static uses are local decision comparison and/or local JSON capture/supervisor records. No remote HTTP/auth client import, HTTP Authorization header, or remote auth API use was found in those helpers.
static_review.residual_note: These opaque constants are still local execution-control markers. The review did not execute the helpers and does not validate external state or future use outside the inspected files.

a12_workspace_support_supplement.remote_credential_assessment: No potential live credential found in the scanned archive source/configuration/documentation. The sole hit is a known public AWS example sentinel in source checker logic.
a12_workspace_support_supplement.scope_note: The final full pass includes the refreshed archive manifest and the newly added 3,511-byte record_delivery_boundary.py. Runtime/vendor paths were not pruned; suffix selection covered source, configuration, and documentation files throughout the tree.
